name: Vaporgoth
summary: The term was coined by the artist Chinese Hackers to describe their own releases in 2015.
description: The term was coined by the artist Chinese Hackers to describe their own releases in 2015. The style is defined by a dark, distorted, and often minimal sound, paired with a visual aesthetic that is similarly cryptic and horror-inspired. Related terms that describe a similar style include Deathdream and Spookwave. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Darkness, alienation, dread, technological horror, surrealism

visualDNA.colour: Black, white, muted greys, occasional digital blues or greens

recipe.technique: Richard Backus was cast as Andy Brooks after the casting director was impressed by his intense, quiet stare. Christopher Walken had also been considered for the part. Gary Swanson was briefly cast in the part, and even appeared in test footage that was later featured in the film's Blu-ray release from Blue Underground. Bob Clark cast John Marley and Lynn Carlin as Charles and Christine Brooks, based upon their performance as a dysfunctional couple in John Cassavetes' Faces. Unbeknownst to Clark, the two actors did in fact have genuine animosity, which bled onto the set of Deathdream.
